displayName: Coding-Workbench Adapter Contract (VS Code / Codex / IDE / future)

translationRules.translatesNeverRedefines: An adapter maps framework behavior onto a native surface. It never changes what a control means, only how it is expressed.
translationRules.noAuthorityOrigination: An adapter never becomes an authority. It cannot approve, cannot classify risk, and cannot resolve a source conflict.
translationRules.noProjectGovernance: An adapter carries no project-specific governance. Project rules live in the Profile, not the adapter.
translationRules.noStateInvention: An adapter may not invent, rename, merge, skip, or reorder a governed lifecycle state or gate.
translationRules.noIndependenceCollapse: An adapter may not collapse required independent steps into one invocation for convenience.

capabilityMap.translationNote: Editing sessions operate on a governed work item
IDE-run tests map to framework evidence
Delegates repository operations to the repository adapter
IDE surfaces the approved technology registry; unapproved dependency use is a violation
Where the IDE supports workspace-scoped tooling; declared per concrete IDE

prohibitions: A new coding workbench is added by implementing this contract, never by redefining the framework
IDE convenience features never override a governed gate
Local green build is not acceptance

evidenceTranslation.rule: IDE-run checks are evidence only when reproducible outside the IDE. A result that only reproduces inside one developer's IDE is not portable evidence.

handoffTranslation.rule: Handoff via committed branch + evidence, delegated to the repository adapter.

lifecycleSyncRule: IDE reflects work-item state via the repository adapter; it holds no independent state.
